definitions.explanation: A plate or sign displaying the resident's name at the entrance of a home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{表札|ひょうさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}けた→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧。
{表札|ひょうさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I confirmed the address by looking at the nameplate.

notes:
{表札|ひょうさつ} is a nameplate displayed at the entrance of a home showing the resident's family name.

ETYMOLOGY:
{表|ひょう} (display) + {札|さつ} (plate/tag).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {表札|ひょうさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to put up a nameplate
- {表札|ひょうさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掛|か}ける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to hang a nameplate
- {表札|ひょうさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}ける→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧: to install a nameplate

MATERIALS:
- ⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧: wooden
- ⟦{金属製|きんぞくせい}→金属製：28457_kinzokusei⟧: metal
- ⟦{陶器|とうき}→陶器：14531_touki⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: ceramic
- ⟦アクリル→アクリル：28698_akuriru⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: acrylic

CULTURAL NOTES:
- Traditional for Japanese houses, less common on apartment buildings
- Some people avoid {表札|ひょうさつ} for privacy or security reasons
- Design can range from simple to ornate, reflecting household taste
